detail.longDescription:
Attached: 3 images

Blindtus, my little movie guessing game, finally has accounts. Which mostly means nothing gets thrown away.

Your streak, your win rate mode by mode and every day you have played now live in your profile. 

And since you can add friends by username or invite link, you get to compare your daily results with them, then see where everyone lands on the leaderboard, friends or worldwide, from today to all time.
